items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Chu Berry and all of them would take me out on gigs with them.

ctx.x: Yes. When I was in around 5th or 6th grade they used to come to Pittsburgh and they'd drive this big bus on our street, all these musicians, Chu Berry and all of them would take me out on gigs with them.
Because you were that well known?
